dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: Ah, esteemed visitors, this must be a fated meeting! Are you interested in seeing a place of great significance to the Guhua... Oh my, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your fated meetings been going?

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: I've had quite a few earnest guests come with me to Wangshan Hall. No doubt due to the fortune you brought, of course...

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: They didn't leave much Mora behind, but they certainly did contribute to Wangshan Hall's repair fund.

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: Do drop by if the fancy strikes you, by the way!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still need me to make you a meal?

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no! Your sincerity was well-felt indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: On the contrary, it should be I who should whip up a good dish for you, or perhaps treat you to a restaurant meal!

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: Uh, hang on a moment, let me check our expenses over the last few days...

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: *cough* Well, let's have that feast another day, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Huang the Third
dialogues.text: You are most kind! May we meet again!
